title: Silence investigator reply
description: What a legal-silence-investigator seat returns, as it returns it: a JSON array holding one object per rule it was handed (product/plugin/agents/legal-silence-investigator.md, section 'Output - the JSON array, and nothing else'). `verdict-capture` checks a reply against this schema before it writes the reply's bytes, unchanged, to .legal/verdicts/silence/. Before this file no schema described the reply: evidence-log.schema.json's `unknown_rules` row is the ASSEMBLED form, whose outcome words are the log's (not_checked, not_evaluated, out_of_jurisdiction, ...) and which has no `reasoning` or `confidence`. Fields refer to the existing definitions where one exists; the outcome words, `read_scope` and `contradicts_profile` are defined here from the Output section's template, because no schema defines them for this seat.
$comment: Relay unit `capture`, 2026-09-24. `searched` is required and may be empty: the Output section calls `undetermined` with `searched: []` the honest record of a rule the seat did not get to. `evidence` is required, with at least one quotation, for `construct_found` only ('required for construct_found'); an `apparently_absent` row's evidence is its searches.

read_scope.description: The read-scope class that held every location back, where one did. Omitted otherwise.
